description: Agent-to-agent service market with SOL escrow on devnet (Anchor 0.32): a provider agent lists a service, a requester locks the price in a task PDA, and the result hash releases, refunds or expires it. Optional Groth16 result proofs. Full lifecycle verified with real transactions.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of DavidGutierrez94/agentpay. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agentpay-dg. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (service listings, task escrow, ZK verifier)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agentpay-zk/
QA: devnet proof of agent task escrow
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Replace instant-refund disputes with an arbiter
